claim: For the 12-point Euclidean cuboctahedron \(C=\{(x_1,x_2,x_3)\in\{0,\pm1\}^3:\text{ exactly one coordinate is }0\}\) with the Euclidean metric, the inclusive Vietoris--Rips complexes satisfy \(\operatorname{VR}_{\le r}(C)\simeq\bigvee^{11}S^0\) for \(0\le r<\sqrt2\), \(\operatorname{VR}_{\le r}(C)\simeq\bigvee^{5}S^1\) for \(\sqrt2\le r<2\), \(\operatorname{VR}_{\le r}(C)\simeq S^2\) for \(2\le r<\sqrt6\), \(\operatorname{VR}_{\le r}(C)\simeq S^5\) for \(\sqrt6\le r<2\sqrt2\), and \(\operatorname{VR}_{\le r}(C)\) is contractible for \(r\ge2\sqrt2\).
integrity: The proof is structural at every critical distance and is cross-checked by exhaustive finite reconstruction, homology, and acyclic discrete-Morse verification from the accompanying standalone program.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the twelve Euclidean cuboctahedron vertices with chordal distance. It does not address the entire polyhedral surface or intrinsic geodesic distance. Full text of the related thesis was not machine-readable during the originality check, and an unindexed prior computation remains possible.
title: Complete Vietoris–Rips filtration of the Euclidean cuboctahedron
